_what_this_is: The six offers, from data/offers.yml — the only file a price exists in. Prices are pence. Use these numbers exactly; never invent one.
_deposit_rule: t3 and t4 take a fifth on the order and the rest when the work is in your hands: £100 of £500, £300 of £1,500. These are two Stripe products each (DEPOSIT and DELIVERY) that sum to the price — draw the split as a real thing.

offers.question: Can I just have the pack?
offers.gets: Every file in the vault for the shape you picked, downloaded by you — the behaviour policy, the grant and the mandate as markdown and as JSON, the pinned vocabulary, the prompts, the business case, and the two files you hand the agent — under a commercial licence to you, rather than under the attribution licence the same files carry in public.
offers.state: Built, and it runs today. Fifteen template shapes are published, and the pack for any of them is what this level sends.
offers.eta_from: the moment the payment goes through
offers.eta_why: Nothing is made to order. The pack exists before you arrive and the page you land on is the download.
offers.post_when: Immediately. The page you land on after paying IS the download, with the size and the sha256 printed beside the link.
offers.post_does: Download the zip and check the hash. The page does the hashing in your own browser, against the hash it publishes.
offers.name: The pack, downloaded

offers.question: Can I have a vault I hold the keys to?
offers.gets: A vault of your own with the pack in it, a licence carrying your name, and no public key on it.
offers.state: Built, and it runs today. A template shape is built into a vault by one command; yours is that, licensed to you, with the public key off it.
offers.eta_why: A shape is built into a vault by one command; what takes the day is doing it for you, with your licence on it and the public key off it.
offers.post_when: A person follows up within 24 hours of the payment landing. The vault key comes by a separate message.
offers.post_does: Nothing until the follow-up. Then clone the vault with the key.
offers.name: A working vault

offers.question: Can you correct it for my situation?
offers.gets: The vault, with the mandate corrected against your situation rather than against a starting assumption, and a written note of what changed.
offers.state: **Done by a named security professional**, and done many times: six vaults of this work are published and open to read, including an eleven-step risk-acceptance walk over one evolving register. What you buy at this level is that person's time turned on your situation rather than a template's.
offers.eta_from: from your reply, not from your payment
offers.eta_why: The clock starts when you send the industry, the use case and the details, because until then there is nothing to correct against. It is said this way round because it is the way round that is true.
offers.post_when: A person follows up within 24 hours. The corrected vault follows what the prompt produced.
offers.post_does: Run MAP-A-GRANT.md where the agent runs — it ships in every template zip and in every vault, so you have it before and after paying — and send back the two files it writes, grant.json and mandate.json, and the session record, with no secret in them and your order reference on the message.
offers.name: Corrected for your situation

offers.question: Can somebody go through it with my team?
offers.gets: Two half-hour sessions with your team, the behaviour policy built from the interview, and a security professional's review and sign-off.
offers.state: **Two sessions with a named security professional**, who reviews the work and signs it off. The method is published and open to read — an agent's grant, its mandate and the delta between them, and eleven linked threat models presented at a conference in Barcelona.
offers.eta_from: from your reply, not from your payment
offers.eta_why: Depends on load. The constraint is one person's calendar rather than a warehouse, and saying so is more use to you than a word borrowed from a shop that holds stock.
offers.post_when: A person follows up within 24 hours to book the first session. The vault follows the second.
offers.post_does: Reply with two or three slots and who will be in the room.
offers.name: Two sessions and a custom vault

offers.question: Can I have the same result in a form the board will read?
offers.gets: The same result as a document, a deck, an infographic, and in a second language.
offers.state: The generator exists. The check that proves every variant carries the same facts does not, so the guarantee that would make this worth buying is not printed here yet.
offers.eta: With the level it attaches to
offers.eta_why: An add-on is not shipped on its own and does not have a date of its own.
offers.name: Board-readable and other formats (add-on)
